1. Introduction 
Xerox eTerminal is a Gespage software module dedicated to Xerox EIP (Extensible Interface 
Platform)/ ConnectKey MFPs. This module uses the integrated touch screen of the MFP. 
 
This module enables an authentication at the MFP to provide the following functions: 
- 
Secured release at the printer (Print2me). 
- 
Tracking of the copying and scanning. 
- 
Functionality of scan to home email. 
 
Authentication on the MFP may be carried out by keypad or card. 

Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - 003

Gespage eTerminal Xerox 
 
6
1.1 Compatibility 
Gespage eTerminal is compatible with Xerox EIP (Extensible Interface Platform)/ ConnectKey 
MFPs. It does not support the 57xx, 71xx and 74xx ranges. 

Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - 003

2.1.2 Configuration via the MFP web interface 
When configuring your MFP via the web interface, it is recommended to check that the MFP is not 
turned off or on standby and that nobody is logged in on it. 
 
ATTENTION! Each MFP model has its dedicated web interface, the following photos may not look like 
your web interface. Nevertheless, tabs and functions are available. The MFP used for the screenshots 
is a Xerox WorkCentre7225. 
 
The web interface of your MFP is accessible by just entering its IP address in your browser, using the 
ID « admin » and the password (default is « 1111 »). 
 
Once logged in, move to the « Properties » tab, then to Login/Permissions/Accounting/Login 
Methods and click the pen to modify the configuration.

2.2.1 General 
2.2.1.1 
Global parameters 
Gespage server (IP or name) address has to be checked in the global parameters of the server 
(Server/ Global Parameters) to make the dialogue possible between eTerminals and Gespage server. 

Make sure that the licenses wished are available. From Server / Support / Licence, information about

(Server/ Global Parameters) to make the dialogue possible between eTerminals and Gespage server. 

Make sure that the licenses wished are available. From Server / Support / Licence, information about 
your Gespage Server and the licenses bought are available. An eTerminal can be installed only if you 
have the Xerox eTerminal associated license or if your server is in demo mode. 

After supply, a new license is saved by just uploading and validating. 
2.2.1.2 
Networks flows 
Xerox eTerminal communicates with Gespage service on the secured 7181 TCP port. 
The server monitors the Xerox eTerminal by using the SNMP protocol (UDP 161 port).

2.2.2 Configuration of an eTerminal 
Before configuring the MFP, the printer matching your MFP must first be configured on your server 
Gespage. 
 
Xerox eTerminal should be added under Gespage, then associated with the MFP print queue. 
Above parameters remain accessible for later changes. The method for print release is defined here, 
as well as the functions managed by the eTerminal. 

2.2.3 eTerminals general configuration 
In Xerox eTerminals general configuration, set up the parameters to be applied to all Xerox 
eTerminals on the site. 
 
The type of login allowed and the method for card association are among these parameters. 
 
NOTE: Card login is automatically enabled as soon as a compatible card reader is connected. 
 
Xerox TCM3 is advisable:

The main parameters are described hereafter: 
 
Authentication method used with Cartadis terminal 
They are the input parameters dedicated to a user login on the keyboard. 
 
Input of Gespage account only: 
The user will only enter his Gespage login. 
 
Input of account and password: 
The user will only enter his Gespage login and his password. 
 
Input of the print code: 
 
The user will enter his print code. 
 
Xerox card association parameters 
Association card ID to user 
At the first user’s card use and if the card number is not known by Gespage, a method of 
association of the card must be defined. It enables the number of the user card to be stored in 
Gespage account. This association only applies at the first card insertion. 
1. Done by the users 
When a user will use an unknown card, he will have the possibility of entering his 
login/password at the menu which normally displays pending prints. The card self-
association will be required only once during the card life time. 
2. Done by the administrator 
All card numbers of users have to first be configured in Gespage. The initialization can be 
carried out by the administrator or by the LDAP synchronization mechanism. 

Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - 003

This is the time limit in seconds to enter the login/password to associate the card after it has 
been passed. After this limit, the card association will be ignored at the server.

Xerox account parameters 
Minimum value of account to login 
For the limited accounts, it is the minimum value of the account to authorize login. 
 
Allow negative balance in GUI 
For the limited accounts with negative credit, if this parameter is enabled, the list of prints is 
displayed. Otherwise, a message of insufficient credit is displayed to the user. 
 
Maximum number of printouts in GUI 
Limits the number of prints displayed in the list (in case of MFP memory limitation). 
 
Device locale 
Defines the language of the graphic interface of Gespage on the MFP. 
2.2.4 eTerminals advanced configuration 
Parameters related to each eTerminal are modified by following the path Terminals/List of Terminals, 
and choosing the eTerminal wished. 
 
General parameters & advanced

2.2.4.1 
Identification of the eTerminal 
Name 
The name of the eTerminal must be filled in. The name is free but 2 identical names cannot be 
entered. 
MFP address 
The address of the MFP is the IP address or the network name of the MFP on which the 
eTerminal is to install. 
Comments 
Comments are optional. 
2.2.4.2 
Release of prints 
Print job release 
Indicates whether printings sent to the MFP are locked as long as the user is not identified. 
1. Manually 
The user must always identify himself to release his documents. This is the configuration to 
choose for getting a secured printing. 
2. Automatically 
The documents are printed as soon as they are received if the user’s credit is sufficient, they 
are nevertheless accounted.

Manual releasing condition 
In case of manual release of printings, this parameter indicates whether all printings are 
automatically released or the user can select the ones that he wishes to release. 
1. All jobs are automatically released after user login 
After authentication of the user, all pending prints will be released.

2.2.4.3 
CMI 
This field (« Join a CMI ») is to fill in if you need a CMI network reader. The CMI serial number 
should be entered. This CMI is configured at the CMI terminal. 
 
NOTE: Xerox TCM3 may be connected directly in USB to the MFP. 
2.2.4.4 
Management of services 
Manage copy 
Selecting this service enables the copies made by the user to be accounted. 
Manage scanning 
Selecting this service enables the scans made by the user to be accounted. 
Manage fax 
Selecting this service enables the fax made by the user to be accounted.

If jobs are managed, the user can enter or look for the job on which he wishes to apply his work. The 
information should be entered after having selected « Billing code » from the print menu.
